I have enough understanding. Let me analyze the bug.

The issue: `alias()` adds an annotation with `select=False`, which calls `set_annotation_mask(set(self.annotation_select).difference({alias}))`. When `annotation_select_mask` is `None` (meaning "all annotations selected"), this converts it to an explicit set. But the real problem is in `RelatedIn.get_prep_lookup`: it checks `has_select_fields` which returns True if `annotation_select_mask` is truthy. After `alias()`, the mask becomes a set that may be non-empty, so `clear_select_clause()` is skipped.

Let me look at the `alias` method in queryset to confirm.
